highlights.title: Walter Torous named executive director of MIT Center for Real Estate
highlights.summary: The senior lecturer, already director of the degree program, will now oversee all aspects of the center’s activities and operations.
body: Walter Torous, senior lecturer in the MIT Department of Urban Studies and Planning (DUSP) and the MIT Sloan School of Management, and director of the Master of Science in Real Estate Development Program (MSRED), was recently named executive director of the MIT Center for Real Estate (CRE) — effective July 1, 2026.

In announcing Torous’ appointment, School of Architecture and Planning Dean Hashim Sarkis also said that Justin Steil, professor of law and urban planning, will represent CRE as faculty chair of the Academic Curriculum Council.

“Together, Walter and Justin will guide CRE’s academic and strategic direction as it continues to strengthen its role within our school and the Institute,” Sarkis said. “Their appointments reflect the center’s distinctive position at the intersection of finance, design, planning, technology, and public policy — and its long-standing commitment to understanding real estate not only as a market force, but also as a driver of urban transformation and social change.”

highlights.title: Final Fantasy Meets Zelda in Steam's Best New RPG
highlights.summary: Years before the iPhone debuted in 2007, Square Enix began developing Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest games for Japanese mobile phone networks. Games like Before Crisis: Final Fantasy VII were built for Japan's then-advanced flip phones, with gameplay mechanics reliant on hardware like a camera…
body: It took only a few years for touchscreen smartphones to eclipse the popularity and viability of flip phones for video games. RPG franchises like Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest, and Fire Emblem all have wildly popular mobile entries. But one RPG franchise, developed natively for mobile phones, is often overlooked. Over 15 years ago, Zenonia proved that mobile phones could run complete, console-worthy games — without ties to an outside IP.

Developed and published by Gamevil, Zenonia first launched in 2008 for mobile phones in South Korea. It reached the United States’ App Store in 2009 and the Google Play Store in 2010, before getting Nintendo DSi and PlayStation Portable ports. A few years after dropping off several mobile game stores, such as the iPhone App Store, gamers can once again experience Zenonia’s classic RPG gameplay on PC.

highlights.title: The rise of AI ‘civilizations’ and the fall of corporate responsibility
highlights.summary: Depending on who you ask, developer platform Hugging Face was recently attacked by OpenAI - after it lost control of its own AI tools - or by a succession of AI "civilizations." Welcome to the linguistic battlefield of AI safety, where word choices can shift responsibility for a massive…
body: Until last week, the details surrounding the OpenAI-Hugging Face hack felt fairly settled. In July, a cybersecurity test of one of OpenAI’s autonomous AI agents went wrong. The agent escaped its supposedly isolated test environment, accessed the internet, and hacked Hugging Face, alongside several other organizations. A good deal remained unknown, and there are many serious questions left around safety and governance, but the basic shape was clear. Detailed accounts from OpenAI and two independent research groups were supposed to fill in the gaps, but when they published their reports last week, it turned out the hack was much stranger than it initially seemed.

It’s a lot to parse. Between them, the reports run to around 130 pages, much of which is both dense and highly technical. A few days later, Dwarkesh Patel, a podcaster little known outside of tech circles but with outsized reach and influence among Silicon Valley’s AI establishment, set out to tell “The whole OpenAI/Hugging Face story in plain English.” He titled his Substack blog “The Rise and Fall of Agent Civilizations.”

Both Apple and Google changed the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America following a similar executive order signed by Trump last year. Meanwhile, MapQuest refuses to change the name of either body of water, something that has likely helped propel it to the top spot on Apple’s App Store.

The lawsuit revolves around three former Apple employees who recently joined OpenAI, including Chang Liu, who allegedly kept a company-owned MacBook after leaving Apple.

Apple accuses OpenAI of failing to inspect the laptop “despite having the MacBook in their possession since the start of the lawsuit” in July. highlights.title: New Avengers: Secret Wars Casting Announcement Sparks Wild Fan Theories
highlights.summary: With just a few months to go until Avengers: Doomsday hits movie theaters, casting rumors are ramping up for next year's sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars. Marvel Studios has said very little officially about 2027's Avengers movie, particularly when it comes to casting.
body: Thanks to a new report from Deadline, we finally have some unofficial casting news for Avengers: Secret Wars.

British actor Noah Jupe has reportedly joined the cast of Avengers: Secret Wars, according to Deadline. Jupe's role in the sixth Avengers movie was not revealed, but his character is "expected to play a key part in the story," Deadline said. Jupe is best known for his roles in the A Quiet Place films, where he plays Marcus Abbott, the son of Emily Blunt and John Krasinski's characters. Jupe also appeared in Eternals director Chloé Zhao's Oscar-winning Hamnet (as Hamlet) and in The Night Manager with Tom Hiddleston. Jupe recently co-starred alongside Spider-Man: Brand New Day 's Sadie Sink in the West End production of Romeo & Juliet.

In the absence of official confirmation, fans have speculated on a number of possible roles for Noah Jupe in the MCU. Top of the list seems to be Franklin Richards, son of Reed Richards and Sue Storm, who is a newborn in The Fantastic Four: First Steps. Given that some MCU youngsters — namely T'Challa II from Black Panther: Wakanda Forever — are apparently aging up in the MCU, perhaps Franklin Richards will too.

These experiences offer as much external peace as they do internal, and even long after the session and trip have ended, it's those stirring, outdoor moments that endure. They feel like they’ve stopped time and are worth going out of the way for—planned or spontaneous. And what's better than practicing your asanas in a phenomenal natural setting? With these 10 best places for yoga, grab your go-to mat and embrace your inner yogini.

The middle of the Indian Ocean is possibly the most unique spot one can find to do yoga. Practice asanas while sailing on a traditional wooden dhow at this Maldivian resort. Lux* South Ari Atoll organizes this cruise at golden hour with an instructor guiding you on Tibetan Sound Bowl therapy, breathwork, and yoga. Sip on a refreshing drink, inhale a mood-enhancing oil blend, and float on the waves as you meditate and feel your mind reset.

body: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use agents for onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. Their examples show what enterprise leaders can borrow.

OpenAI’s latest Enterprise Signals shows enterprise AI moving from assistance to execution at sharply different speeds. Frontier firms (those with the top 10% of AI usage) now generate 8.3× as many output tokens per active user as typical firms, up from 2.6× in January. The widening gap points to a deeper operating shift: leading firms connect agents to company context and tools, delegate more substantive work, and make successful workflows easier to repeat.

For leaders, the challenge is to turn that depth into work people can trust, measure, and improve. Leaders should also leave room for experimentation, including use cases whose value is not obvious on the first try.

body: During her seven years in commodity sales and trading at Goldman Sachs, Nancy Twine learned a very important piece of life advice: “Just figure [it] out.” Her career since has had several arcs.

And that’s where her story begins today. If you were to meet Twine right at this very moment, she might laugh that she’s giving birth twice this month: to a baby girl (any day now!) and a new hair-care brand called Soulstice, officially available to shop today.

While sitting next to her at Sant Ambroeus in New York, Twine is as light and calm as ever, despite experiencing such pivotal life accomplishments in such quick succession. “It’s kind of cool to launch this brand while I’m this pregnant,” she says with a smile. When I ask her how she does it all, she returns to that old mantra: “I just go figure it out.”

highlights.title: Pokémon is Getting Its Own Official Fitbit for Evolved Sleep Tracking
highlights.summary: Pokémon has spent the past decade finding increasingly creative ways to bring its monsters into the real world. Pokémon Go turned your neighborhood into a Pokédex, while Pokémon Pokopia lets players build their own Pokémon paradise.
body: If you've been snoozing with Snorlax, you now have a new way to show off your sleep stats. Google has announced a new Pokémon Sleep edition of the Fitbit Air, a new tracker designed to work directly with Pokémon Sleep and give the wearable a fresh makeover.

The newly announced Pokémon Sleep edition is a themed version of Fitbit Air, Google's tiny sleep and health tracker. The 5.2-gram tracker is designed to be worn around the clock, with an optical heart-rate monitor, accelerometer and gyroscope, SpO2 sensors, and a skin-temperature sensor.
It can store seven days of detailed, minute-by-minute motion data and up to 30 days of daily totals, while its battery lasts for up to seven days.

There isn't any special technical advantage to the Pokémon version, though. It's essentially the same Fitbit Air under the hood, just with a Pokémon Sleep -themed design. But it's an easy way to let everyone know you're serious about your Pokémon without having to say it.

highlights.title: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
highlights.summary: A classic chicken noodle soup with juicy chicken, tender vegetables, and deeply flavorful homemade broth.
body: There are plenty of shortcuts you could take with homemade chicken noodle soup, but this recipe isn’t interested in them. A whole chicken simmers with onion, carrots, celery, garlic, dill, and peppercorns to make its own deeply savory, golden broth. It takes a little time, but the result is about as classic and comforting as chicken noodle soup gets.

The key to juicy chicken is treating the breasts and legs differently. Once the breast reaches 155°, you’ll pull the bird from the pot and remove the breast meat to keep it moist. The legs, wings, and carcass go back in, allowing the dark meat to become fall-apart tender while the bones and cartilage-rich wings impart richer body and flavor.

A fresh round of carrots and celery goes into the strained broth along with the pasta, so the vegetables cook until tender without turning to mush. Ditalini is ideal here because the tiny rounds cook quickly right in the broth; other small shapes work too (more on that below). A generous handful of fresh dill added at the end keeps things bright, but parsley or chives make good substitutes.

highlights.title: OpenAI Is About to Release Its First AI Model With ‘Critical’ Cyber Abilities
highlights.summary: The company will give select partners early access to its Astra AI model—so they have time to shore up their defenses.
body: OpenAI announced Tuesday that its forthcoming AI model, Astra, is its first to reach the company’s threshold for what it calls “critical” cyber capabilities. OpenAI says it plans to publicly release a version of Astra “soon,” but will make the model’s advanced cyber capabilities available only to select partners in its Daybreak Blue early-access program at launch.

In a briefing with reporters, OpenAI safety and security leaders said the company has concluded that Astra reaches the critical cybersecurity capabilities outlined in its preparedness framework, which sets thresholds and protocols for when its AI models pose new levels of risk. The company says an AI model has reached its critical cyber threshold when it can independently find and exploit previously unknown vulnerabilities in real-world software. OpenAI leaders said the company has followed its procedure for this situation, which is to halt further development until appropriate safeguards and security measures can be implemented.
points: The company will give select partners early access to its Astra AI model—so they have time to shore up their defenses.

highlights.title: ‘A great feeling’: Mykhailo Mudryk seals loan move from Chelsea to Tottenham
highlights.summary: Deal for Ukrainian winger has £75m purchase option. ‘I’m so excited to be reunited with De Zerbi’ Tottenham have thrown a Premier League lifeline to the forgotten Chelsea winger, Mykhailo Mudryk, signing him on loan just before the transfer deadline and challenging him to revive his career.
body: Mudryk became a €100m (£89m) player when Chelsea took him from Shakhtar Donetsk in January 2023; the deal comprised an initial €70m and €30m in add-ons. Chelsea beat Arsenal to his signature at a point when the Ukrainian was among the most in-demand players in Europe.

The move to Chelsea did not work out and Mudryk hit rock bottom when he was banned for returning an adverse reading for the banned substance, meldonium, which can increase respiratory capacity and stamina. His last competitive game for Chelsea was on 28 November 2024.

Mudryk was suspended before being given a four-year ban by the Football Association. But after an appeal to the court of arbitration for sport, he was able to resolve his case with the FA at the end of July, being cleared for an immediate return to playing. He accepted breaking anti-doping rules and agreed to a suspension that was equal to the time he had already served. The FA noted that changes have been made to the World Anti-Doping Agency’s rules on meldonium and had Mudryk’s test been conducted today then “the concentration of meldonium in the sample would not have been reported” and no adverse finding would have been recorded.

Rockstar is promising a reworked character customization system that will help players tell unique stories. The world is also upgraded: better visuals and smarter, more reactive NPCs. nopixel will offer more ways to make money, whether you want to play as a hardened criminal or a law-abiding citizen. The update introduces new areas, like a grand hotel-casino and a revamped version of Cypress Flats.

Those are the new bits, but Rockstar says there's a lot more to come. According to a Rockstar blog post, GTA 5 will eventually receive other improvements, such as a new PC game overlay, more events, and "expanded access" to nopixel.
The post reads, "Every player helps shape the city, and every relationship matters."

The closed beta for nopixel begins on Sept. 8 and will be available straight out of the Rockstar Games Launcher. "GTA Roleplay has never felt more alive, and there has never been a better time to tune in," Rockstar says.

body: For decades, testosterone has been marketed to men as a means to maximise virility. But in recent years, social media has fuelled the “T-maxxing” trend, in which men are encouraged to maximise their testosterone levels through either natural or artificial means.
Low testosterone is being blamed in the rightwing manosphere for a crisis of masculinity; global search interest in the term is up 60% from last year.

Popular podcasters such as Joe Rogan and Andrew Huberman openly talk about taking testosterone, as has the 72-year-old Robert F Kennedy Jr, who has said he uses testosterone replacement therapy as part of an “anti-ageing protocol”.

Elsewhere in the Trump administration, the US defence secretary, Pete Hegseth, announced in July that soldiers 30 and over would be tested annually to ensure they have the “right testosterone levels”.
